verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs a plain-language request end to end: an agent drafts the intention and proposes tasks, a person approves them, and an agent (Claude Code or Codex) running in your checkout claims a task, does the work and opens a pull request. Deliverables are then tracked across PRs. However, the implementing agent is a third-party tool, and nothing in the evidence says the agent writes tests; the only PR quality signal is an advisory product review. missing for 10: any evidence that agents write or run tests, first-party implementation rather than relying on external agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end runs.
